states.entryRequirements: A draft request/checklist exists; no evidence acquisition or receipt is implied
states.allowedTransitions: AWAITING_SOURCE after separate owner acquisition authorization and actual sending; RECEIVED_UNVERIFIED only for separately authorized intake of originals already privately held
states.requiredEvidence: Draft scope, owner authorization and actual action reference kept private; never invent a sent request

states.entryRequirements: A separately authorized request was actually sent and source delivery is pending
states.allowedTransitions: RECEIVED_UNVERIFIED on separately authorized actual private receipt; REQUEST_PREPARED for revised unsent scope
states.requiredEvidence: Private request/channel reference, scope and honest dates; no source assumed available

states.entryRequirements: Original bytes privately received under separate authorization, quarantined; no identity or source acceptance
states.allowedTransitions: INTEGRITY_VERIFIED after technical byte/custody checks; REJECTED_INTAKE on failed safety/scope checks; SUPERSEDED when a genuine replacement is documented
states.requiredEvidence: Private custody receipt, original byte identity/size, schema and outstanding issues; no original contents in logs

states.entryRequirements: Original retained bytes and manifest pins/schema/custody have passed technical integrity checks only
states.allowedTransitions: IDENTITY_REVIEW_PENDING only when every mandatory qualification-readiness gate is met; REJECTED_INTAKE for new invalidity; SUPERSEDED on evidenced revision
states.requiredEvidence: Exact original/derivative hashes, technical validation reference and current issues; issuer authenticity and identity are separate

states.entryRequirements: All review-entry gates supported, no unresolved mandatory issue, real authorized reviewer available; review not yet acceptance
states.allowedTransitions: RECEIVED_UNVERIFIED if new uncertainty requires quarantine; REJECTED_INTAKE for invalid input; SUPERSEDED on replacement
states.requiredEvidence: Gate bundle, scope, authentic reviewer-availability proof and private source references; no invented reviewer identity

states.entryRequirements: An authorized intake operator declines unsafe, corrupt, wrong-scope or otherwise unsuitable intake; this is not a financial rejection decision
states.allowedTransitions: Terminal for this evidence version; a corrected new version starts separately
states.requiredEvidence: Safe issue codes, private rationale/custody record, original bytes preserved according to future approved policy

states.entryRequirements: A genuine source revision/replacement and its exact affected scope are documented
states.allowedTransitions: Terminal for this evidence version; replacement has a new opaque evidence ID and fresh checks
states.requiredEvidence: Predecessor/replacement references and issuer revision provenance; no latest-wins or deletion of original audit
